title: Github
text: Github is where I store all my software repositories. This also includes the code for this website! Click the title to see my projects!

title: Volunteering
text: I have volunteered for various teaching positions to teach students about computing concepts that are tougher to understand (such as data flow or database management) which develops my communication skills. Within the past year, I've volunteered with Edinburgh Science to introduce young people into STEM careers, talking about the path I've taken to get where I am, as well as showing that STEM isn't just about the Engineers, the Doctors or the Lab technicians, but it encapsulates much more than that such as Technical Writing, Product Managment and Design.
